description: This file defines the CustomerOrder controller class for the OpenCart admin report extension, handling report display, saving settings, and generating customer order reports.

classes.name: CustomerOrder
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer order reports in OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the report page, loads language, sets breadcrumbs, and renders the report form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report settings, checks permissions, and returns success or error in JSON.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the customer order report list with order statuses.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the customer order report list.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates the customer order report data with filtering, pagination, and view rendering.
